newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med opens 15.8 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Club Med opens 15.8 percent lower.

text.p: Shares in Club Mediterannee opened more than 15 percent down after a total of 30 minutes limit-down suspension following the group's profit warning on Tuesday evening.
At 0833 GMT, the share was down 17.09 percent at 330 francs.
Club Med said on Tuesday it expected its pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit for the second half of 1995/96 to be similar to the year-earlier level.

"The overall climate in continental Europe has exacerbated the tendency of clients to seek out less expensive packages, particularly in the latter part of the summer," the resort company said in a statement.
The warning led brokers to change their recommendation to sell and analysts have downgraded their 1996 forecasts.
